title: TADPOLE Five-Group Semantic and CAM-Only Fidelity Experiment
fallback_reason: Preferred OSSFS create/write probe returned EIO errno 5.

folds.transductive_patient_graph: true for G1-G4; absent for G5
folds.rfe_and_standard_scaler_scope: complete dataset before outer cross-validation, inherited historical protocol

groups.G1_E28_E0: Original SPromptGL TADPOLE CAM/GFR/RES with a frozen MMGPL-12 3-class PEN. Original PEN MLP and local/global fusion are retained. The two-class semantic competition is extended to three class prompt rows.
groups.G2_E43_1_E00: E83.4 formal No-PEN, independently replayed from Best and Latest. PEN is physically absent.
groups.G3_E74_4_G2: E83.4 formal DARG Positive-DCR, independently replayed from Best and Latest with original graph fusion, losses, optimizer and ten-epoch warmup.
groups.G4_E82_4_6_10_G1: New DARG+DPSL training from matching G3 fold warmup. Three class-pair routes use normalized queries and a fixed RN50 Gram-preserving Cholesky adapter.
groups.G5_E43_4_E0_ANCHORED_PHYSICAL_CAM: New physical CAM-only TADPOLE training. Each fold reconstructs an untrained E83.4 G2 TADPOLE CAM initialization in isolation, restores its CAM Adam and construction RNG, then trains only CAM parameters.

g4_dpsl.pair_supervision_scope: only training rows whose class is a member of that pair
g4_dpsl.query_normalization: normalize before both attention and pair context
g4_dpsl.text_adapter: float64 normalized RN50 Gram, deterministic Cholesky, pad 12x12 factor to 12x32, no learned parameters
g4_dpsl.differential_query_branch: not active in registered source configuration; diagnostic-only anonymous query remains available

g5_physical_cam_only.tadpole_anchor_method: Rebuild E83.4 G2 fresh CAM initialization in an isolated reference model; preserve CAM state, one CAM Adam initial state, and post-construction RNG. Do not copy trained weights.

training.selected_gpu_workers: determined by measured throughput among 1, 2, 4, 8, and 10
